gloss.intro: The words developers (and the AI crews) use, in plain English.
gloss.switch.help: Dotted words get a plain explanation when ye hover 'em.
gloss.backlog.text: Ideas and work not planned in yet. Nothin' there gets worked on until it moves to Yet to do.
gloss.sprint.text: A short stretch of work (often a week or two) with an agreed set of cards to finish.
gloss.standup.text: A quick check-in: what each crew member did, what they do next, and what be stoppin' 'em.
gloss.bug.text: Somethin' that doesn’t work the way it should.
gloss.test.text: Tryin' a finished piece of work to check it does what was asked, before ye accept it.
gloss.commit.text: A saved snapshot of the code, with a short note of what changed. Ye can always go back to one.
gloss.push.text: Sendin' saved snapshots (commits) from this computer up to GitHub, so they be backed up and shared.
gloss.branch.text: A separate line of work in the code, so changes can be made without touchin' the main version.
gloss.merge.text: Joinin' a branch’s changes back into the main version.
gloss.repo.text: The project’s folder of code and its full history of commits, usually also kept on GitHub.
gloss.refactor.text: Tidyin' the code without changin' what it does: smaller files, clearer names, less repetition.
gloss.deploy.text: Puttin' a new version live, for example onto a server where folk use it.
gloss.kanban.text: A board with columns (To do, In progress, Done) where cards move left to right as work happens.
gloss.wip.text: Work in progress: the most cards a column should hold, so the crew finishes things before startin' more.
gloss.pr.text: Askin' for a branch’s changes to be checked and merged into the main version.
gloss.hook.text: A small command that runs by itself at a set moment, e.g. when an AI session starts, so the crew hears yer comments.
gloss.token.text: The unit AI usage be counted in: roughly a few letters of text read or written. Fewer tokens, more of yer plan left.
gloss.agent.text: An AI that works on its own on a task: reads the code, makes changes, runs checks, and reports back to the captain.
